title: Self-Balancing Sequential Sampling: Fast Convergence with Controlled Predictability
abstract: arXiv:2607.20818v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many instances of sequential sampling, including audit and inspection scheduling, representative sampling, and treatment assignment, require selections to be distributed evenly without becoming easy to anticipate or exploit. We study a family of sequential sampling rules that adaptively bias sampling probabilities in order to achieve faster convergence of the empirical distribution to a desired target law, while keeping the resulting samples as unpredictable as possible. The resulting self-balancing sampler is simple to implement, arises naturally among a class of Markovian samplers sharing a certain invariance property, and admits a stochastic mirror-descent interpretation. translated_title: 自平衡序贯抽样：受控可预测性下的快速收敛
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.20818v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：许多序贯抽样的实例，包括审计和检查调度、代表性抽样以及处理分配，要求选择能够均匀分布，同时又不至于容易被预测或利用。我们研究了一族序贯抽样规则，这些规则自适应地偏置抽样概率，以实现经验分布更快地收敛到期望的目标规律，同时保持所得样本尽可能不可预测。由此产生的自平衡抽样器实现简单，在一类具有某种不变性的马尔可夫抽样器中自然出现，并允许随机镜像下降解释。我们的主要结果表明：(i) 该自平衡抽样器以最快可能的 $O(n^{-1})$ 速率收敛，且对偏置参数有显式依赖，优于独立同分布抽样的标准 $O(n^{-1/2})$ 速率；(ii) 它是自然问题的唯一解。
tldr: 本文提出一种自平衡序贯抽样方法，通过自适应偏置抽样概率，在保持样本不可预测性的同时实现最快的 $O(n^{-1})$ 收敛速率，优于标准独立同分布抽样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-balancing sequential sampling method that adaptively biases sampling probabilities to achieve the fastest $O(n^{-1})$ convergence rate while maintaining sample unpredictability, outperforming standard IID sampling.
